source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
A player’s rules, as against their opponent’s, are:

- their army rules
- the detachments in their army
- the Stratagems they use
- the Enhancements their units or models have
- the abilities and rules on their units’ datasheets

A rule with a usage limit, such as once per battle, turn or phase, limits only the player it belongs to.

A rule a mission adds counts as a player’s rule when that player uses it. One that no player uses and that always applies is resolved first, ahead of all the active player’s rules, in the order that player chooses.
